display: PEARL ROSE ULTRA · 8.4.1 — Эффекты и автообновление
details: The user's screenshot displayed 'Новое!' in the cloud updater, proving a stale 8.3 page had not loaded the 8.4 intro. Future mobile homes self-refresh once per detected new build (with cache-busting query), avoiding reload loops and leaving editors untouched. Added visible 'Эффекты' replay controls on home/More and Revision, slow typing refined to headings, category cards, and active nav. A manual tap opts into requested animations even if Android reduced-motion is enabled; default retains accessibility preference. No changes to inventory, cloud data, TTK, PDF, projects or native APK. Visual Android WebView confirmation outstanding.
